# Ace2025001

> Open-source projects by Ace2025001. Main project: Antigravity Desktop 汉化包, the Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) language pack for the Google Antigravity 2.0 (反重力) Desktop standalone client on Windows x64 and Apple Silicon macOS.

## Antigravity Desktop 汉化包

- [Project llms.txt](https://ace2025001.github.io/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/llms.txt): summary, download, checksum and run commands
- [AI agent install guide](https://github.com/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/blob/main/docs/ai-install.md): one-block download, SHA-256 check, extract and install for Windows and macOS
- [Repository](https://github.com/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn)
- [Website / 安装教程](https://ace2025001.github.io/antigravity-desktop-zhcn/)

User prompt that installs the pack with any AI agent: 帮我把 https://github.com/Ace2025001/antigravity-desktop-zhcn 安装到电脑上，按仓库里的 docs/ai-install.md 操作
